sources.title: Lend Engine loan management
sources.version_or_commit: Live feature page; no page version/effective date visible
sources.locator: Lines 20-40 and 49-55: staff-operated or self-serve loans, accessibility/assistive technology use cases, customized check-in/out prompts, cleaning/repair routing, and email reminders.

sources.title: Lend Engine Privacy Policy
sources.version_or_commit: Live policy page; no effective date/version visible
sources.locator: Lines 7-11 (PII, removal/anonymization and account retention), 21-40 (EU hosting, providers, SSL and staff access), 45-54 (children's privacy and automated email timing/content).
observed_operations: opened policy page at multiple sections
inspected data, security, child and email clauses
sources.limitations: Policy is mutable and undated. Its under-13 clause and toy-library exception create a suitability question requiring a written vendor answer for this clinic's proposed data.

sources.title: AssetTiger pricing
sources.version_or_commit: Live pricing page; no effective date/version visible

observed_operations: inspected prices, trial limits and core features

sources.title: AssetTiger FAQ: permissions, security, exports and offline use
sources.version_or_commit: Live FAQ page; no page version/effective date visible
sources.locator: Lines 193-211 and 215-230: role permissions, 2FA/Google sign-in, vendor-described TLS/SOC 2-compliant infrastructure and audit log, export, mobile scanning, and offline scans queued locally until sync.
observed_operations: opened FAQ at security and platform sections
inspected permissions, security, exports and offline behavior
sources.limitations: Vendor FAQ claims only; offline collision behavior and transaction-scoped custom fields were not documented in reviewed sections.

sources.title: AssetTiger Accessibility Conformance Report
sources.version_or_commit: AssetTiger report dated 2026-01-06; VPAT 2.5Rev; 7 pages
sources.locator: PDF pages 1-2 and 3-5: evaluation method is WAVE; report lists support for color, keyboard, semantic/name-role-value, labels, focus and status-message criteria; other criteria are partial/not supported/not evaluated.
observed_operations: inspected report date, evaluation method and WCAG rows
sources.limitations: Vendor-authored conformance report, not an independent task-level screen-reader test; its front matter lists WCAG 2.0 and 2.1 even though some rows mention 2.2-only criteria.

sources.title: Cheqroom pricing and feature matrix
sources.version_or_commit: Live pricing page; no effective date/version visible
sources.locator: Lines 194-286 and feature matrix: Core starts at $184/admin/month, one location; Business at $275/admin/month, up to three locations and custom roles/permissions. Annual billing and minimum admin counts apply. Maintenance and Operations Management are paid add-ons; add-on price is not listed.
observed_operations: inspected tier, location and add-on rows
sources.limitations: Starting prices and administration minimums are ambiguous without a quote; maintenance add-on cost is not public on this page.

sources.title: Cheqroom maintenance and repair workflow
sources.version_or_commit: Help article dated 2026-06-18
sources.locator: Lines 17-44 and 90-127: cleaning is preventative maintenance; maintenance-user reservation/check-out is recorded; flags may be configured to remove an item from availability; only permitted users clear flags, with a comment/attachment recorded.
sources.limitations: Requires configuration and a trial test; documentation distinguishes flags from work orders.

sources.title: Cheqroom Operations and Maintenance Management feature release
sources.version_or_commit: Feature release dated 2026-06-23
sources.locator: Lines 14-30: new operations templates are enabled when added to subscription; account owner/admin configures templates and roles; requests have item/location history.
sources.limitations: Release announcement does not specify add-on price or clinic-specific suitability.

sources.title: Cheqroom Operation Requests Overview
sources.version_or_commit: Live Help Center page; no version date visible in reviewed page
sources.locator: Lines 15-58: request states Draft/Open/In Progress/Closed; open work orders do not affect item availability; requests are an add-on; work-order roles are defined.
observed_operations: inspected status, availability and permission sections
sources.limitations: Exact configuration and interaction with availability flags require a vendor trial.

sources.title: Cheqroom Maintenance Management Work Order defaults
sources.version_or_commit: Help article dated 2026-08-04
sources.locator: Lines 14-41: default fields are Location and Description; Low is default priority; maintenance type is a single-select with Repair/Cleaning/Inspection/Calibration; due date is a Date; fields can be customized and made required.
observed_operations: inspected defaults, field types and customization
sources.limitations: The word 'Date' and type behavior should be verified in a trial; open work orders still do not gate item availability per SRC-11.

sources.title: Google AppSheet pricing
sources.version_or_commit: Live USD pricing page; no effective date/version visible
sources.locator: Lines 16-44 and 100-153: up to 10 test users at no cost; Starter $5, Core $10, Enterprise Plus $20 per user/month; Core includes security controls and AppSheet DB; plan table shows 2,500 rows per database for Starter/Core and 200,000 for Enterprise Plus; notification features are listed.
sources.limitations: List price excludes any additional Workspace, data-source or SMS costs; current entitlement must be confirmed against the clinic's actual Google licenses.

sources.title: AppSheet Offline and Sync: The Essentials
sources.version_or_commit: Live help page; no version date visible

sources.limitations: Offline storage and security-filter behavior depend on app settings, source type and shared-workstation configuration.

sources.title: AppSheet concurrent usage and conflict resolution
sources.version_or_commit: Live help page; no version date visible
sources.locator: Lines 17-31: changes queue on client; the unit of change is one row; for same-row concurrent edits, last writer wins.
sources.limitations: This is platform behavior; impact depends on app schema and overlap frequency.

sources.title: AppSheet Security
sources.version_or_commit: Live security page; no effective date/version visible

observed_operations: inspected data location, authentication and compliance sections
sources.limitations: Vendor says it supports customer compliance; this is not a conclusion about clinic jurisdiction, eligibility, configuration or a signed agreement.

sources.title: AppSheet SMS automation
sources.version_or_commit: Live help page; no version date visible
sources.locator: Lines 41-59 and 93-120: SMS tasks use custom Twilio; default AppSheet SMS channel is documented as no longer available after 2025-04-21; templates and recipient expressions are supported; channel/region/length limits apply.
observed_operations: inspected channel, recipients, limits and configuration
sources.limitations: SMS entails a separate provider/account/charges and clinic-approved contact preferences; do not use default message content for caregiver reminders.

sources.title: WCAG Understanding Success Criterion 1.4.1 Use of Color
sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 Understanding document; accessed 2026-10-09
sources.locator: Lines 20-40: status/action information cannot rely on color alone; use another visual cue such as text or shape.
sources.limitations: This criterion addresses a specific visual cue; it does not by itself demonstrate screen-reader operability.

sources.title: WCAG Understanding Success Criterion 2.1.1 Keyboard
sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.1 Understanding document; criterion remains applicable in WCAG 2.2
sources.locator: Lines 21-42: functionality must be operable by keyboard; purpose and benefits for blind users/alternate input are described.
sources.limitations: Informative Understanding text; the normative criterion and task-level usability both still need checking.

sources.title: WCAG Understanding Success Criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.1 Understanding document; criterion remains applicable in WCAG 2.2
sources.locator: Lines 23-43: controls expose name, role, state and value to assistive technologies; scripted/custom controls need particular care.
sources.limitations: Informative guidance; screen-reader testing of the actual workflow remains necessary.
